decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered PL01, E01 C, Location Plan and Design & Access Statement Received 03/08/2010and Amended Plans PL01A Received 22/09/2010, PL01B, PL02 Received 23/09/2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western elevation of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Separate access to the residential accommodation on the upper floors of the premises shall be available to residents at all times.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a scheme of acoustic insulation and any associated ventilation to ensure the maximum noise level to be permitted within dwellings with windows shut and any other necessary means of ventilation provided shall not exceed the "good" limits contained in BS8233:1999. These being LAeq, 16hour = 30 dB in living rooms, and a night (07:00-23:00) LAeq, 8hour = 30dB and LAFmaz = 45 dB in bedrooms, and a night LAeq, 1hour = 45 dB in Kitchens, Bathrooms and Utility Rooms".  The details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 7 - The extension to the hot food takeaway restaurant hereby approved shall be used for the purposes ancillary to the main use of the restaurant and as such shall not form part of the public floorspace without prior approval from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 9 - The ventilation system when operating at any fan speed shall be 10dB(A) below existing background noise levels measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any 24-hour period and shall be mounted on anti-vibration mountings.

Condition : 10 - The extract system as indicated on the approved plans shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-carbon and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher. The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be serviced annually.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, for a scheme of reducing carbon emissions from the total energy needs (heat, cooling and power) of the development by at least 20%, by the on-site generation of renewable energy, unless it can be demonstrated that such a provision is not feasible. The details shall be carried out as approved.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the restaurant. Erection of a first floor extension over part of ground floor with roof garden and change of use to self contained flat.
